title: Friend re-launches its AI pendant with a speaker that talks to you, for twice the price
summary: Everyone hated it, so Friend is making it even more expensive. Shiffmann posted a tweet of the new ad, calling it “Friend 2.0,” even though the product is still just called “Friend” on its site.
